exports.name: ScreenfullService
exports.summary:
Cross-browser wrapper around the Fullscreen API (with vendor-prefix fallbacks) to
request/exit fullscreen on a given element.
exports.summaryZh: 跨浏览器封装的全屏 API（含各厂商前缀兼容），用于对指定元素请求进入/退出全屏。

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Exits fullscreen if currently active, otherwise requests fullscreen on the given element.
methods.descriptionZh: 若当前处于全屏则退出全屏，否则对指定元素请求进入全屏。

methods.name: request
methods.description: Requests fullscreen on the given element (or `document.documentElement` if omitted).
methods.descriptionZh: 对指定元素请求进入全屏（未指定时默认为 `document.documentElement`）。

properties.name: keyboardAllowed
properties.description: Whether this browser's fullscreen API accepts a keyboard-input-allowed flag (Safari 5.1 workaround).
properties.descriptionZh: 当前浏览器的全屏 API 是否接受"允许键盘输入"标志（用于兼容 Safari 5.1）。

properties.name: isFullscreen
properties.description: Whether any element is currently displayed in fullscreen.
properties.descriptionZh: 当前是否有元素正处于全屏状态。
